config.source:
SELECT 'Bronze Records' AS record_class, bronze_rows AS record_count
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Clean Records', clean_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Rejected Records', rejected_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Duplicate Trips', duplicate_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Invalid Distance', invalid_distance_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Invalid Rate per KM', invalid_rate_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Missing City', missing_city_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Missing Payment Method', missing_payment_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Missing Fare', missing_fare_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
UNION ALL SELECT 'Missing Rating', missing_rating_rows
FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
config.comment: Bronze, clean and rejected record counts plus data quality issue counts, unpivoted from the gold data quality table
